006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import java.util.Collection;
009import java.util.List;
010import java.util.Map;
011import java.util.Set;
012import java.util.stream.Collectors;
013
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
017import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
018import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
019import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ICollectionValue;
020import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
021import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
022import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
023import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.function.IMapItem;
024import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.function.IMapKey;
025import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
026import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
027
028/**
029 * Implements the XPath 3.1 <a href=
030 * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-map-remove">map:remove</a>
031 * function.
032 */
033public final class MapRemove {
034  private static final String NAME = "remove";
035  @NonNull
036  static final IFunction SIGNATURE = IFunction.builder()
037      .name(NAME)
038      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS_MAP)
039      .deterministic()
040      .contextIndependent()
041      .focusIndependent()
042      .argument(IArgument.builder()
043          .name("map")
044          .type(IMapItem.type())
045          .one()
046          .build())
047      .argument(IArgument.builder()
048          .name("keys")
049          .type(IAnyAtomicItem.type())
050          .zeroOrMore()
051          .build())
052      .returnType(IMapItem.type())
053      .returnOne()
054      .functionHandler(MapRemove::execute)
055      .build();
056
057  private MapRemove() {
058    // disable construction
059  }
060
061  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
062  @NonNull
063  private static <V extends ICollectionValue> ISequence<?> execute(@NonNull IFunction function,
064      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
065      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
066      IItem focus) {
067    IMapItem<V> map = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(0).getFirstItem(true)));
068    ISequence<? extends IAnyAtomicItem> keys = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(1)));
069
070    return ISequence.of(removeItems(map, keys));
071  }
072
073  /**
074   * An implementation of XPath 3.1 <a href=
075   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-map-remove">map:remove</a>.
076   *
077   * @param <V>
078   *          the type of items in the given Metapath map
079   * @param map
080   *          the map of Metapath items that is to be modified
081   * @param keys
082   *          the keys to remove from the map
083   * @return the modified map
084   */
085  @NonNull
086  public static <V extends ICollectionValue> IMapItem<V> removeItems(
087      @NonNull IMapItem<V> map,
088      @NonNull Collection<? extends IAnyAtomicItem> keys) {
089    Set<IMapKey> keySet = keys.stream()
090        .map(IAnyAtomicItem::asMapKey)
091        .collect(Collectors.toSet());
092
093    Map<IMapKey, V> remaining = ObjectUtils.notNull(map.entrySet().stream()
094        .filter(entry -> !keySet.contains(entry.getKey()))
095        .collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getKey, Map.Entry::getValue)));
096
097    return IMapItem.ofCollection(remaining);
098  }
099}
